'''Rebel Assault Commandos''' were elite [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They wore [[Rebel heavy battle armor/Legends|Rebel battle armor]] and were armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster weapons]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], these [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] patrolled various locations controlled by the Alliance around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In addition, they participated in the [[Invasion of Bestine|Invasions of Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Invasion of Dearic|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Invasion of Keren|Keren]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:GU15" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rebel Assault Commandos were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GU15" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rebel Assault Commandos were added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 15|Game Update 15]]," published on [[January 25]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege Game Update 15">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68602&month=012010|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15)}}</ref>
